section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participant demographics for a study conducted in Malaysia. The initial pool of 863 individuals was reduced to 781 participants (390 women and 391 men) after excluding those who did not meet ethnicity inclusion criteria (Malay and Chinese only). Participants were recruited from Selangor and Kuala Lumpur, with a mean age of 27.27 years and mean self-reported BMI of 23.52 kg/m². The majority (86.2%) had college or higher education.
